text: Seabrook Town’s equalizing goal originated from a high-impact pressing trigger: Aiden Quinlan’s interception initiated a counter-attack that exploited Harbour City's comparatively passive pressing (PPDA 10.7 vs. Seabrook’s 7.0). Quinlan’s long progressive pass to Kian Adeyemi rapidly advanced play into the final third, triggering a wide overload that stretched Harbour’s 4-2-3-1 defensive shape. This sequence highlights Seabrook’s effective transition mechanism combined with wide positional play to destabilize Harbour City’s patient short-passing strategy and restore parity at 2-2 [#1442] [#1443] [#1444] [#1445] [#1446] [#1448].
